name: Testing authentication with Robot Framework
description: This test suite verifies that the tests are run correctly and that they cover the required functionality.

tests.name: Run tests and extract traces
tests.description: Run the Robot Framework tests and extract traces for further analysis. Passing this step does not guarantee that your tests covered the required functionality, which is checked by the subsequent tests.

tests.name: Code quality check
tests.description: Checks the code quality of the Robot Framework tests using the [Robocop linter](https://github.com/MarketSquare/robotframework-robocop). This step does not affect your score, but it can help you identify potential issues in your tests.

tests.name: Login page is visited
tests.description: Checks that the login page was visited during your tests.

tests.name: Login email is validated
tests.description: Checks that an incorrect email address was rejected during your tests.

tests.name: Login password is validated
tests.description: Checks that a short password was rejected during your tests.
tests.run: ./.grading/find_trace.sh 'Password must be at least 6 characters long.'

tests.name: Correct credentials are used
tests.description: Checks that a successful login was completed during your tests.

tests.name: Login username is case insensitive
tests.description: Checks that a successful login was completed during your tests with an email address in a different case.

tests.name: Invalid credentials are used
tests.description: Checks that a failed login attempt was rejected during your tests.

tests.name: Logout feature is used
tests.description: Checks that the user was logged out during your tests.

tests.name: Dashboard is visited while unauthenticated
tests.description: Checks that unauthenticated access to the dashboard was rejected during your tests.
tests.run: ./.grading/find_trace.sh 'You must be logged in to enter the dashboard'

tests.name: New account created successfully during registration
tests.description: Checks that a new account was created successfully during your tests.

tests.name: Registration page form validation is completed
tests.description: Checks that missing registration fields were rejected during your tests.

tests.name: Duplicate email address is rejected during registration
tests.description: Checks that registration with an existing email address was rejected during your tests.

tests.name: Registration email is case insensitive
tests.description: Checks whether the tests included a registration attempt with an email address in a different case than an existing account.
